content.rationale: The checks are where D16c's exercising, D9's checks (validity, resolution, kwwsoosw's coverage, and history topology), O10's line rendering, the per-verb --help promise, and the argument refusal (C) meet; this check drives the handler over scratch repos whose node files are named by real change ids and pins each failure line to the check that produced it — a clean graph silent, an invalid node, an unresolved target, an uncovered decision edge, and the root edge out of scope, and that the handler is the table's shape — a `Verb` row for it compiles (M-route). It reaches store_list/store_resolve/store_load, so it is a crate of its own. I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the crate is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive, and I1-schema (`zmmyomyp`) fixes the validator these documents are checked with. It pins the read's refusal site (S2-read-refusal-site, vollyzvn): an unreadable node is a validity line, never a silent skip. It also pins the crossing rule (D-read-bulk, rkoktpwt) and set-backed resolution (S2-resolve-in-set, opqlqqvu): two fixtures with the same node count and different edge counts make the same number of `file show` crossings and report the same lines, so the resolution per edge no longer adds a read. It also pins the fourth check against S-topology (`zrkzppqo`): the verb's one reading of order is the order M-node-set reports for the set, so the check adds no crossing as the graph grows, a history-ordered graph reports nothing, an edge whose target is not older is exactly one `topology <id> <target>` line under O10, a target the set cannot place stays resolution's line alone, and the verb's own help names the check it reports. The fifth check is pinned the same way the other four are: a change whose recorded diff touches a path its own node does not own is one `custody <id> <path>` line per disagreeing path, the line naming the path, under the same O10 shape and with no verdict, and a graph whose changes stay inside their owning sets is silent — including a change that touches a path its own content.ref lists, because the owning set is taken as given from xzxtxymq, not restated and not narrowed to the node file (xotxspwp). The rule the pass applies is xotxspwp's as given and the read it applies it to is kywmkqlm's one crossing (jj_custody::read), which the crate shims beside the modules it already carries; the fixtures read jj's own diff summaries so no expectation about history comes from the handler. Reporting and not repairing is asserted on the tree: after the run the offending change's recorded diff, its node document and the file it strayed onto are unchanged — no edit moved, no change rewritten, no document amended so the diff would fit — which is what xotxspwp's refusal of repair means. And the verb's own help names the five checks: validity, resolution, coverage, topology and content custody. The owning set the fifth check compares the read's paths against is S2-own's (`lwnnssuo`, `src/node_own.rs`) and taken as given: the pass compares those paths with the set `node_own::owned` derives from the loaded document and the parsed id, so it has one derivation of the ownership rule rather than a second copy of that rule inside the verb, and the layout named there is the module's, not the pass's. The suite's silence case already pins the derivation the comparison rests on — a path a change's own content.ref lists is inside the owning set — so the same fixtures that pin the fifth check exercise the set it is compared with. O10's line form is pinned the same way where a check in the run could not itself run: the fixtures refuse the custody read's one crossing — the listing whose template carries `diff.files()`, distinct from the set's `files("nodes/")` candidate listing and its change-to-commit mapping, so the set is still read and the run reaches the fifth check — and assert that the run reports one `custody - <jj evidence>` line rather than refusing: the check's name in O10's first position, the stand-in in the id position because no single node or change is implicated there, and jj's evidence in the third, which is the evidence the failed crossing produced. The other four checks' findings are reported in the same run, so a check that never ran does not take the four's findings down with it, and the tree the run reported on is left as it was found — no document amended, no edit moved, no change rewritten. The refine closes the silent skip the pass used to leave: the set read it makes is the one that also reports the candidate changes it drops for want of their own document (`node_set::list_with_drops`, S2-set as refined by nykqvuqr), so every change that touches the node store is accounted for exactly once in one run. A candidate carrying no document of its own is named by one `validity <id> <reason>` line per change, however many paths under `nodes/` its diff touched, spelled with the id the set reports — the same spelling every other line prints — so a buffer that edits a sibling's document and a change carrying stray files there are named the way a node is. Naming a drop is not making it a node: it is not put back in the set to be named, so no resolution, coverage or topology line is ever about it, and it is given no owning set, so custody does not report its diff as strayed onto either. Every other candidate is the set's node and custody's to attribute, as before: a loaded node's stray path is still one `custody <id> <path>` line, a node whose diff stays inside the set its own document gives it is attributed and silent, and a node whose document is present but did not load stays validity's node rather than becoming a drop as well — it carries a document of its own, so the failure validity already reports is its one line. The line's reason is pinned only as far as the decision fixes it: the third position carries the check's reason under O10, and no wording beyond that is pinned. What the refine leaves alone is asserted beside it: a clean graph is still silent, the five checks' existing lines keep their form and count, the fourth check still adds no crossing, and nothing is repaired — no document is created for a change that carries none, no document amended, no edit moved, no change rewritten, no verdict recorded.
